key_insight: Epitaxial 0.5PZT-0.5PFN thin films show strong polarization-dependent photocurrent, indicating intrinsic coupling between ferroelectric order and photovoltaic response.
engineering_relevance: This single-phase multiferroic platform is promising for polarization-tunable photovoltaic devices and optoelectronic memory elements.
method: Pulsed laser deposition of 0.5Pb(Zr0.52Ti0.48)O3-0.5Pb(Fe0.5Nb0.5)O3 on SrTiO3 (001)
SrRuO3 bottom electrode enabled electrical and photoresponse measurements
Characterized structural, ferroelectric, magnetic, and monochromatic 403 nm photovoltaic behavior
evidence_signal: The films were single-phase and (001)-oriented, with remanent polarization around 17 μC/cm², weak room-temperature ferromagnetism, and polarization-dependent Jsc values of approximately ±20 μA/cm² under 403 nm illumination.
watch_item: The reported photoresponse is measured under monochromatic laser illumination, so device-scale performance under broadband or operating-condition conditions remains to be validated.
paper_title: Enhanced Photocurrent Response in Epitaxial 0.5PZT-0.5PFN Multiferroic Thin Films
